column3: Close to the Greek.
NASB follows the critical text without “brethren”; “commend” is rendered “praise,” “teachings” is “traditions,” and “are keeping” is “hold firmly to.”
NASB follows the critical text; “know” is rendered “understand,” and it reorders the clauses.
NASB renders “dishonors” as “disgraces.”
NASB follows the critical text; “dishonors” is rendered “disgraces,” and “with which shaven” is “with her whose head is shaved.”
NASB renders “be shorn” as “have her hair cut off.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “since.”
NASB renders “is of” as “originate from.”
NASB renders “on account of” as “for … sake.”
NASB renders “authority” as “a symbol of authority,” with “a symbol of” supplied.
NASB renders “without” as “independent of” and moves “in the Lord” forward.
NASB renders “of” as “originates from” and “through” as “has his birth through.”
NASB renders “Becoming” as “proper” and “revealed” as “with head uncovered.” A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
NASB follows the critical text without “or.”
Close to the Greek.
NASB renders “custom” as “practice.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “giving” and “you.”
NASB follows the critical text; “assembly” is rendered “church.”
NASB follows the critical text (“also”).
NASB renders “coming together in one place” as “meet together.”
NASB reorders the verse; “drunken” is rendered “drunk.”
NASB adds “What!” and restructures the end of the verse.
Close to the Greek.
NASB follows the critical text without “Take, eat” and “broken.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “He took” and renders “having supped” as “supper.”
NASB follows the critical text without “this” before “cup.”
NASB follows the critical text without “this”; “unworthily” is rendered “in an unworthy manner.”
Close to the Greek.
NASB follows the critical text without “unworthily” and “of the Lord”; it adds “if” and renders “discerning” as “judge … rightly.”
NASB renders “are fallen asleep many” as “a number sleep.”
